Minimal pipeline to build `plot_band_power_correlation_grid` for the
uncorrected relative band-power maps (bilateral MICCAI regions).

## Setup

Import the band-power helpers and IO functions, set the random seed, and define
data paths, the analysis frequency range (0.5-80 Hz), and the output figure
directory.

```{python}
#| label: imports
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")

from pesco.bandpower import (
    compare_region_band_power,
    plot_band_power_correlation_grid,
    region_band_power,
    relative_band_power_by_channel,
)
from pesco.io import load_sources, prepare_psd
from pesco.pipeline import DatasetCtx
from pesco.preprocess import compute_psd

seed = 3
np.random.seed(seed)

PROJECT_DIR = Path("/Users/daniel/PhD/spectral-comparison/code/")
DATA_PATH_SOURCES = Path(f"{PROJECT_DIR}/data/Mantini2018")
DATA_PATH_IEEG = Path(f"{PROJECT_DIR}/data/Frauscher2018")

FREQ_RANGE = (0.5, 80.0)

fig_dir = Path("figures/chapter2")
fig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

## Load data

Load the raw iEEG atlas (Frauscher) PSD with region metadata — no bandpass, no
normalization, so power stays in raw units for the relative-power step.

```{python}
#| label: load-ieeg-raw
ieeg_raw = DatasetCtx(name="intracranial data (raw)")
ieeg_raw.f, ieeg_raw.psd = prepare_psd(
    matfile=DATA_PATH_IEEG / "WakefulnessMatlabFile.mat",
    region_dict_file=DATA_PATH_IEEG / "RegionInformation.csv",
    frauscher_bandpass=False,
    normalize=False,
)
assert ieeg_raw.psd is not None
```

Load the HD-EEG source-reconstructed data (Mantini), compute a PSD per source
channel over the same frequency range, and assemble a channel × frequency
dataframe with the source metadata joined on.

```{python}
#| label: load-hd-raw
sources_raw, sources_meta = load_sources(DATA_PATH_SOURCES)
hd_data = sources_raw.get_data()
hd_fs = sources_raw.info["sfreq"]
hd_f, hd_psd = compute_psd(hd_data, hd_fs, fmin=FREQ_RANGE[0], fmax=FREQ_RANGE[1])

hd_psd_df = pd.DataFrame(
    hd_psd,
    index=pd.Index(sources_raw.ch_names, name="ch_name"),
    columns=hd_f,
).join(sources_meta)
```

## Relative band power per region

Compute relative band power for every channel in each dataset, pool them, then
average channels within each bilateral MICCAI region. `compare_region_band_power`
pairs the two datasets region-by-region and returns the paired per-region values
plus the per-band Spearman correlations.

```{python}
#| label: uncorrected-relative-bandpower-bilateral
ieeg_raw_band_power = relative_band_power_by_channel(
    ieeg_raw.psd, ieeg_raw.f, dataset="iEEG atlas"
)
hd_raw_band_power = relative_band_power_by_channel(
    hd_psd_df, hd_f, dataset="source HD-EEG"
)

raw_band_power_by_channel = pd.concat(
    [ieeg_raw_band_power, hd_raw_band_power], ignore_index=True
)
raw_region_band_power_bilateral = region_band_power(
    raw_band_power_by_channel, summary="mean", roi_level="bilateral"
)

(
    raw_band_power_paired_bilateral,
    raw_band_power_correlations_bilateral,
) = compare_region_band_power(
    raw_region_band_power_bilateral,
    x_dataset="source HD-EEG",
    y_dataset="iEEG atlas",
    roi_col="roi_bilateral",
    n_label="n_regions",
)
```

## Correlation grid figure

One scatter panel per band (band shown in the facet strip with its Pearson r):
source HD-EEG vs iEEG atlas relative band power, one point per bilateral region,
colored by anatomical lobe with a single black OLS fit line per panel. A dashed
`y = x` identity line shows any systematic offset between the two modalities.
Axes are free per panel. Saved as SVG to the figure directory.

```{python}
#| label: uncorrected-bandpower-correlation-plot-bilateral
#| output: true
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 3.3
#| fig-cap: "Janiukstyte-style correlation of uncorrected relative band-power maps. Each point is one bilateral MICCAI region; channel powers were averaged within region before correlation."
fig = plot_band_power_correlation_grid(
    raw_band_power_paired_bilateral,
    raw_band_power_correlations_bilateral,
    color_by="lobe",
    method="pearson",
    identity_line=True,
    x_label="source HD-EEG\nrelative band power",
    y_label="iEEG atlas\nrelative band power",
    title="Uncorrected PSD: bilateral regional relative band-power correspondence",
)
fig.save(
    fig_dir / "uncorrected_relative_band_power_correlations_bilateral.svg",
    verbose=False,
)
fig
```
